# Mote v1.1.0-rc.1 - Windows Desktop preview

This preview brings Mote to Windows as a lightweight native application built with Tauri 2. The existing Web/PWA remains available at https://mote.namnth.com.

## Download and install

Download the Windows x64 `.exe` installer from **Assets** below. The matching `SHA256SUMS.txt` lets you verify the download.

The installer is currently **unsigned**. Windows SmartScreen may warn that the publisher is unknown. Only install it if you trust the source.

## What's new

- Windows Desktop installer using the same Mote editor, Markdown Preview and UI as the Web/PWA.
- No account or backend. Notes are stored locally in the Desktop application's IndexedDB.
- Existing Markdown improvements and fixes made since v1.0.1, including stable mobile typing and view scroll behavior.
- Separate release automation produces Windows installers and uploads them to GitHub Releases.

## Moving existing notes

Desktop and browser/PWA storage are **separate**. To move notes from the Web/PWA version, use **Settings > Export backup** on the Web app, then **Settings > Import backup** on Desktop. Importing a backup replaces the destination library.

## Preview limitations

- This is a **pre-release**. The automated Windows build and frontend tests have passed on the PR build, but manual testing of installed WebView2 behavior, especially file import/export and PDF printing, is still required.
- No automatic sync, desktop auto-updates or code signing in this preview.
- Keep a backup of important notes before trying the Desktop build.

Report issues at https://github.com/namnth2000/mote/issues.
